basis: per-case wall times extrapolated from MEASURED pilot timings; NOT measured upper bounds
unit_note: job launches, not scalar observations; sweeps contain multiple arms
allocation_elapsed_basis: job wall time + ~25% for gating, settle, reservation and inter-case overhead
host_rss_basis: planning ceiling per instruction; 6 torchrun ranks x ~2 GiB plus a vLLM parent; actual RSS never measured in the pilot
disk_basis: measured artifact sizes: 60s energy record 260 KB, training record 30 KB, streaming JSONL ~1.2 MB at 100 requests
cpu_analysis_basis: independent reintegration of 24 energy windows plus statistics, audit and report generation

uncertainty.job_wall: +/-50%: extrapolated from 5-step diagnostics to 30-step runs; startup dominated the measured cases
uncertainty.not_measured_upper_bounds: these are estimates, explicitly not measured upper bounds
uncertainty.twelve_hours: a LIMIT, not a completion guarantee
